def _do_ignore_order_get_old(self, obj, remove_indexes_per_path,
        fixed_indexes_values, path_for_err_reporting):
        """
        A generator that gets the old values in an iterable when the order was supposed to be ignored.
        """
        for index, item in enumerate(obj):
            # Skip items that are in the remove_indexes_per_path dictionary
            if index in remove_indexes_per_path:
                expected_value = remove_indexes_per_path[index]
                if item != expected_value:
                    self._raise_or_log(FAIL_TO_REMOVE_ITEM_IGNORE_ORDER_MSG.format(
                        index, path_for_err_reporting, expected_value, item))
                # Remove the index from the dictionary since we've processed it
                remove_indexes_per_path.pop(index)
                continue
        
            # Skip items that match values in fixed_indexes_values
            # (since those will be added separately)
            if item in fixed_indexes_values:
                fixed_indexes_values.remove(item)
                continue
        
            # Yield items that should be kept
            yield item
